scalar_storage: C[@Type='EnergyManager2']/Co[@K='<key>']/@Def; absent Def uses catalog default 0. Co/@U is the connector identity, not the parameter value.

O.meaning: Offset grid power: zero targets no grid/storage import or export; positive permits grid/storage draw; negative reserves generated power for grid export/storage charging.
O.encoding: Invariant decimal in Co/@Def; GUI used decimal comma in this Windows session.
O.warning: The existing release get-params direction heuristic incorrectly labels key O as output; do not reuse that classification.

MinSoc.meaning: Minimum storage state of charge; greater than zero prioritizes storage charging until its state of charge is reached.
MinSoc.gui_invalid_attempt: Typing 101 while starting from 100 left 100; this is GUI input filtering, not proof of a CLI error contract.
MinSoc.runtime_dependency: Soc, Spwr and MaxSpwr; documented behavior is not an executed SPS oracle.

MaxSpwr.meaning: Maximum charging power of the storage.
MaxSpwr.gui_invalid_attempt: Typing -1 from 5.5 produced 0, saved by omission of Def.
MaxSpwr.zero_runtime_meaning: unverified; zero is accepted/default storage, not evidence of unlimited charging or disabled storage

loads.container: Twelve direct Load children in priority order, including unused slots. GUI displays priorities 1..12; OIdx binds output L(OIdx+1), not priority.

Id.meaning: Persistent load identity; preserved when GUI changes priority.

U.meaning: Output connected/used flag, not enable checkbox; remains true when an already connected load is assigned zero rated power.

Ncu.meaning: Name customization marker; native name setter sets this to 1.

An.meaning: False/absent Digital; true Analog. GUI and saved XML independently verified.

Anc.meaning: Type customization marker; native type setter sets this to 1.

OIdx.meaning: Zero-based stable output association, 0..11 for L1..L12; NOT load priority. Do not renumber when reordering.

RT.native_setter: Clamp values below 30 to 30; GUI attempted 0 retained previous 30.

MinRt.meaning: Minimum run-time. GUI input is converted via QVariant::toInt then multiplied by 60; 1,5 rounds to 2 min => 120 s.
MinRt.warning: Negative -1 min is accepted and saves -60. Do not invent a nonnegative validity rule or treat the native max-double editor bound as a safe integer conversion bound.

MDay.meaning: Daily minimum run-time; integer minute conversion multiplied by 60.
MDay.gui_invalid_attempt: Typing 1441 produced accepted prefix 144 minutes (8640 seconds), not an error and not clamping to 1440.

tpR.meaning: Deadline selector for daily minimum runtime.
tpR.unknown: Invalid selector and daily-cycle/timing execution not verified.

SwPwr.native_zero_behavior: Setting zero substitutes current MaxPwr. Setting MaxPwr also copies it into SwPwr when SwPwr is zero.
SwPwr.gui_verified_zero_behavior: With MaxPwr=2.5, entering zero saves SwPwr=2.5.
SwPwr.cross_field_note: SwPwr > MaxPwr is permitted (official sample 2.6 > 2.5), not a universal invalid relation.

MaxPwr.gui_verified_zero_behavior: Zero is accepted, XML omits MaxPwr, existing U=true is preserved and the GUI row is pink.

ico.meaning: Icon reference, preserved by the tested edits and reordering.
ico.unknown: Icon picker CRUD/reference validity is not GUI-tested.

operations.read: All 12 records visible, including empty/pink unused rows.
operations.update: Name, mode, preparation, minimum runtime, daily minimum, deadline and power fields edited and saved in an owned offline official sample.
operations.reorder: GUI down swaps direct Load record order with complete Id/attribute records; OIdx remains 0/1 on its original load. Co/@U and all input/reference UUID spellings remain unchanged.
operations.add_delete: No add/delete buttons in the observed dialog. Dynamic creation/removal and duplicate/dangling-reference acceptance remain unverified; do not claim CRUD parity.
operations.unused_feedback: GUI explicitly says unconnected outputs are unused and red; native pink condition is U==0 OR MaxPwr<=0. Zero-rated connected case independently observed.
operations.preservation: Retain empty slots, Load identities, output indices, icon references, all connector/wire UUIDs, unknown attributes and children. Preserve unrelated production/user/alarm data and original fixture bytes. Do not sanitize digit-prefixed 12hTF attributes or strip UUIDs.

blockers: No GUI-executed SPS storage-priority, deadline/day-cycle or MaxSpwr=0 runtime oracle; offline editing is not runtime parity.
Non-finite/scientific numeric input, integer overflow, duplicate Id/OIdx, dangling icon/reference and structural add/delete behavior unverified.
Only Dusk/Sunset deadline values are GUI-save verified; remaining selector labels come from native enumeration and visible popup leads.
All evidence is version-bound to the stated executable; synthetic fixtures are native/implementation cases only, not GUI golden projects.
